claims.value: 21 antibody immunoprecipitation runs using timothy, velvet-grass or recombinant Phl p 5 allergen material.
claims.evidence: The deposited design maps every RAW file to antibody group, batch and allergen source.

limitations: Exact reduction and alkylation reagents, tolerances and modification search settings are not stated in the accessible record.
Recombinant Phl p 5 rows use not-applicable organism part and material type rather than implying intact pollen.
